title: 第42章 你是什么阶级立场
content_zh:
第42章 你是什么阶级立场-《文豪1978：从军旅作家开始》
上一章
存书签
下一章
“现在济民同志可以说是风头无两，《中国青年》杂志复刊第一期就有他的文章，还有采访，赫然是青年人的精神代表嘛。”徐怀中笑着调侃道。
李英端起茶杯，抿了一口后，眉头得意地舒展：“关键是现在的年轻人喜欢文学，济民同志又年轻，又有文气，年轻人喜欢也是正常的。我们去燕大组稿的时候，听到燕大流传着一句话，叫做：
‘中文系，中文系，到头来不如旁边的医学系；77级，78级，到了刘济民面前全没戏。’
你们是不知道，那群中文系学生说起来，让他们郁闷了好一阵。燕大的几个教授走到我面前，拄着拐杖问我，医学院那个年轻人，到底怎么样啊？”
“哈哈哈！”
闲聊之时，现场笑声不断，刘济民神色自如地应对着大家的调侃。
刘济民坐在魏巍、徐怀中等人面前，本身是有点紧张的，不过经过前半场的交谈，此时紧张已经烟消云散。
《中国青年》杂志复刊后，第一期销量用洛阳纸贵来形容犹嫌不足，首印两百七十万册。这个首印数，就连《收获》都不敢尝试。
该杂志发行时收到过停发命令，但经过多方讨论，最终决定继续发行。
当时《中国青年》杂志编辑陈端抿想让刘济民加点批判的内容，刘济民之所以拒绝，就是不想陷入这种漩涡。
他不是普通的学生作家，他是个军人。
随着《中国青年》杂志的热销，“刘济民”的名字在年轻人中间愈发响亮起来。
而刘济民在《中国青年需回答新的时代之问》中对于“抓住机遇，造就新的自己，抓住机遇，造就新的中国”的呼吁，唤醒了许多青年的雄心壮志。
医学院，每天都有燕京的学生去找他，可惜他不在。
后半场讨论相对并不激烈，大家一致认为不同的写作路线可以齐头并进。《解放军文艺》编辑部通过讨论，决定支持并培养新一代的军旅作家，打造一批经典作品。
会议结束后，《解放军文艺》编辑部安排在总部食堂用餐。
走出门没多久，刘济民陡然加快脚步，几乎小跑到一中年首长面前，立正敬礼一气呵成：“团长！”
“哈哈哈，不错，眼神挺好，没忘了咱们379团。你小子真是眼睛一眨，老母鸡变鸭，座谈会都开上了。”高团长笑着打量着刘济民，“娘的，看来还是首都养人呐，都胖了！”
“团长，您来总政是？我中午请您吃饭！”刘济民笑着说道。
“不用了，我跟着师长来燕京开会，顺便到总政拿点材料。来了就听说你在这里开座谈会，我来个守株待兔。干得不错，咱们团的工农兵大学生，就你给咱们军争光，师长来的路上，还谈起了你的小说。”

"Comrade Jimin can be said to be in the limelight now. The first issue of China Youth magazine included his articles and interviews. He is clearly the spiritual representative of young people." Xu Huaizhong joked with a smile.
Li Ying picked up the tea cup, took a sip, and stretched her brows proudly: "The key is that young people nowadays like literature. Comrade Jimin is young and elegant, so it is normal for young people to like it. When we went to Yanda to draft a manuscript, we heard a saying circulating in Yanda:
'The Chinese Department, the Chinese Department, is not as good as the next door Department of Medicine in the end; Level 77, Level 78, there is no chance in front of Liu Jimin. ’
You don’t know that when those Chinese students talked about it, it made them depressed for a while. Several professors from Yanda University walked up to me and asked me, leaning on crutches, how was that young man in the medical school? "
"Hahaha!"
During the chat, there was constant laughter, and Liu Jimin responded to everyone’s teasing with ease.
Liu Jimin was a little nervous sitting in front of Wei Wei and Xu Huaizhong, but after the conversation in the first half, the nervousness had disappeared.
After the magazine "China Youth" resumed publication, the sales volume of the first issue was not enough to be described as "Luoyang Zhigui". The first issue printed 2.7 million copies. This is a first print run that not even "Harvest" dared to try.
The magazine received a suspension order when it was launched, but after many discussions, it was finally decided to continue publishing.
At that time, Chen Duanqi, the editor of "China Youth" magazine, wanted Liu Jimin to add some critical content. Liu Jimin refused because he did not want to fall into such a vortex.
He is not an ordinary student writer, he is a soldier.
With the popularity of the magazine "China Youth", the name "Liu Jimin" has become more and more popular among young people.
Liu Jimin's call in "Chinese Youth Need to Answer Questions of the New Era" to "seize opportunities to create a new self, seize opportunities to create a new China" has awakened the ambitions of many young people.
In the medical school, students from Yanjing came to see him every day, but it was a pity that he was not there.
The discussion in the second half was relatively less intense, and everyone agreed that different writing routes could go hand in hand. After discussion, the editorial board of "People's Liberation Army Literature and Art" decided to support and cultivate a new generation of military writers and create a batch of classic works.
After the meeting, the editorial department of "People's Liberation Army Literature and Art" arranged a meal in the headquarters cafeteria.
Not long after he walked out of the door, Liu Jimin suddenly quickened his pace and almost trotted up to the middle-aged leader. He stood at attention and saluted in one breath: "Captain!"
"Hahaha, yes, you have good eyesight. You haven't forgotten our 379th regiment. You really blinked your eyes, and the old hen turned into a duck, and the symposium was held." Captain Gao looked at Liu Jimin with a smile, "Damn, it seems that the capital is still raising people, they are all fat!"
"Captain, why are you here for the General Administration? I'll treat you to dinner at noon!" Liu Jimin said with a smile.
"No need, I followed the division commander to Yanjing for a meeting, and stopped by the General Administration to pick up some materials. When I got here, I heard that you were holding a symposium here, so I just waited and waited. Well done. You are the only worker, peasant, and soldier college student in our regiment who has brought glory to our army. On the way here, the division commander even talked about your novel."
